name: Kesoram Industries Limited
summary: Kesoram Industries Limited manufactures and sells viscose rayon, filament yarn, transparent paper, and chemicals in India. It sells its rayon under the Kesoram Rayon brand name; and transparent paper under the Kesophane brand name. The company was formerly known as Kesoram Industries & Cotton Mills Ltd. and changed its name to Kesoram Industries Limited in 1986. Kesoram Industries Limited was incorporated in 1919 and is based in Kolkata, India.
